facts.text: Product title: Sense Ortho Ultra Mattress - Ivory White.
The page lists a Queen / 78 x 60 (198 cm x 152 cm) / 8 (20.3 cm) option, matching the selected variant.
The mattress is described as having a cool-to-the-touch, high-GSM knit fabric cover, a BodyIQ orthopedic memory foam layer, and a firm orthopedic base foam.
With a thicker layer of BodyIQ memory foam that intuitively adapts to every body curve (and yes, zero motion transfer), this mattress makes every sleep feel customized.
Beneath the memory foam is a profile foam layer with an egg-tray structure; the description says it keeps airflow flowing and pressure points zeroed out.
The mattress has a removable, washable zipper cover.
The mattress is described as medium-firm and as offering deep orthopedic support and posture alignment through the night.
